And the balance amount which we have to spend next year is approximately INR450-odd crores.
But broadly, I would say that next fiscal, FY '28, we broadly would expect about 35% to 40% of our total energy consumption to be from renewable sources.
Growth & demand: But other than that, in terms of demand, in terms of container availability, shipping space, et c, I think all of that is, by and large under control.
But generally, we continue to be positive about the industry fundamentals, about demand, about the fact that stainless steel production and demand in India is moving up.
I just want to clear that normally, while we don't give volume guidance, but because we are in a growth phase for FY '27 and FY '28, we have given some indicated volume numbers.
Margins & costs: Costs are up marginally, primarily on account of royalty on chrome, which has gone up a little bit due to elevated ore prices.
Sir, moving on my second question is that we were hopeful of reducing our EBITDA cost per ton by INR3,000, INR4,000 once due to operational synergies once the KNR 2 is up and running.

So slight clarification to that, Aashav, which is that when entire KNR complex comprising 1 and 2 is up and running is where we are looking at a weighted average reduction in EBITDA cost by INR3,000 to INR4,000 on account of better logistics.
Capex & expansion: We will be taking up pre -commissioning activities in July, as we have mentioned, and commissioning in Q2 of FY '27.
On the capex, as you know, we have already spent INR600-odd crores by April.
